target: x86 __cdecl functions and data cells; unsigned int and pointer 32 bits

legacy_startup.declarations: Microsoft Learn __getmainargs/__wgetmainargs, x86 cdecl five parameters; these legacy exports are absent from modern UCRT SDK headers and are not advertised for ucrtbase/API-set DLLs

vcruntime_new.h.projection: x86 __cdecl scalar operator new(size_t) and operator delete(void*), legacy MSVC decorated names

legacy_data.declarations: corecrt_startup.h declares extern char* _acmdln and extern wchar_t* _wcmdln; Microsoft Learn identifies these exported command-line pointer variables. Projected for the three existing legacy CRT profiles only.
legacy_data.adjust_fdiv: Existing x86 MSVCRT compatibility data cell, int32 zero initial value. The installed Microsoft SysWOW64/msvcrt.dll PE exports _adjust_fdiv from its writable, non-executable .data virtual tail, not a code entry. No modern SDK header declaration is claimed.

locale.h.projection: msvcr90 setlocale: x86 __cdecl, int category, optional NUL-terminated const char* locale, char* result; LC_ALL=0 through LC_TIME=5. Also declares unsigned int __cdecl ___lc_codepage_func(void) and struct lconv* __cdecl localeconv(void). The modern SDK lconv wide tail is not projected as VC90 layout.

legacy_locale_handle.declaration: Microsoft Learn previous-versions ff730814(v=vs.120) declares LCID* ___lc_handle_func(void), indexed by locale.h categories. This legacy LCID-array getter is absent from modern UCRT headers; no modern header declaration is claimed.
legacy_locale_handle.projection: msvcr90 x86 CRT cdecl zero parameters, pointer to six 32-bit LCIDs (LC_ALL reserved zero, categories1..5). Authored x86 Microsoft SysWOW64/msvcrt.dll probe confirms C=0, Japanese=0x411, Simplified Chinese=0x804, English=0x409 and mixed category indices; this is a legacy MSVCRT semantic oracle, not a VC90 binary oracle.

legacy_localeconv.source: Microsoft x86 VC90 CRT 9.0.30729.9635 installed in Windows WinSxS
legacy_localeconv.projection: SDK locale.h supplies the zero-argument cdecl pointer-return declaration. Only the legacy 48-byte prefix (ten 32-bit ANSI pointers followed by eight char fields) is published; no modern wchar_t fields or thread-locale API is claimed.
legacy_localeconv.oracle: Authored x86 native probe verifies four supported locale profiles, mixed LC_NUMERIC/LC_MONETARY categories, and currency encoding snapshots across LC_CTYPE/code-page changes. Numeric and monetary categories provide independent data; changing LC_CTYPE alone or setting an unchanged LC_MONETARY locale leaves monetary strings unchanged. A changed monetary locale uses current non-C LC_CTYPE code page, or its own code page with C LC_CTYPE. CP932/936/1252 yen bytes are 5C/A3A4/A5. Results describe the existing virtual locale defaults, not arbitrary host regional customizations.

legacy_calloc_crt.source: Microsoft x86 VC90 CRT 9.0.30729.9635 installed in Windows WinSxS
legacy_calloc_crt.declaration: Modern SDK corecrt_malloc.h declares public void* __cdecl calloc(size_t,size_t); it does not declare this legacy internal export. The VC90 PE export _calloc_crt RVA0x63797 reads stack count/size and returns with RET, and the actual x86 guest call removes both arguments. This is a VC90 binary-backed declaration, not a claimed modern SDK declaration.
legacy_calloc_crt.behavior: Authored x86 activation-context VC90 oracle confirms zero-filled allocation and non-NULL freeable zero-count/size blocks; successful allocation preserves errno. Product beyond 0xffffffe0 sets ENOMEM(12), calls the installed invalid-parameter handler with five NULL arguments and returns NULL. Valid-size allocation failure preserves prior errno and sets LastError8, sampled immediately on return. The internal entry explicitly disables new-handler invocation even with native newmode1/handler installed; only its default zero allocation-retry-delay profile is supported.

corecrt_wctype.h.declaration: const unsigned short* __cdecl __pctype_func(void), with CRT _UPPER/_LOWER/_DIGIT/_SPACE/_PUNCT/_CONTROL/_BLANK/_HEX/_ALPHA/_LEADBYTE masks.

legacy_pctype.source: Microsoft x86 VC90 CRT 9.0.30729.9635 installed in Windows WinSxS
legacy_pctype.behavior: Authored activation-context VC90 probe reads the EOF slot at pointer[-1] and all256 byte slots. C is distinct from localized tables. Japanese/Chinese/English LC_CTYPE names crossed with CP932/936/1252 produce identical classification for each codepage, so the supported four profiles are keyed by CP0/932/936/1252 independently of language and host ACP. Compact classification data is derived from observed tables, not copied from SDK implementation headers.

eh.h.declaration: bool __cdecl __uncaught_exception(void). x86 bool is returned in AL; canonical u32 projection carries the boolean 0/1 value, not a Win32 BOOL declaration.

legacy_uncaught_exception.source: Microsoft x86 VC90 CRT 9.0.30729.9635 installed in Windows WinSxS
legacy_uncaught_exception.behavior: Export RVA0x5ca6b calls _getptd, tests DWORD[PTD+0x90] against zero, sets AL and returns with RET. This corroborates the SDK cdecl zero-parameter bool declaration. Supported profile returns false only for a thread with no active Windows dispatch/unwind or unknown observed C++ exception state; other profiles explicitly fail instead of inventing a processingThrow counter.

stdio.h.projection: x86 cdecl fixed va_list and variadic mandatory parameters for six paired buffer/count families, limited to VC80/90 export profiles

corecrt_wstdio.h.projection: wchar_t pointer parameters and character capacities remain UTF-16; va_list is an x86 pointer, variadic functions retain only mandatory parameter slots
